The pillars of Hajj in the Hanafi school.

items.q: The pilgrim in tamattu' or qiran must offer this.
If no sacrifice is found, the pilgrim fasts this many days in all.

Walking quickly in the first three circuits of tawaf al-qudum, for men.
Uncovering the right shoulder in tawaf, for men.

items.q: Hunting land animals in ihram is forbidden by this verse.
The penalty for killing game in ihram is a like animal judged by this many just men.
The penalty for shaving the head for a reason in ihram: fasting, charity or this.
The Companion with lice for whom the verse of shaving in ihram came down.

The charity option for that penalty is feeding this many poor people.
A woman's ihram: she may not cover her face with this or wear gloves.
A woman in her period may do all the rites except this.
The Mother of the Believers whose period began at Sarif, and who was told to do all but tawaf.

The standing at 'Arafah lasts until this time.

The Companion who fell from his camel and died in ihram; our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said he will rise saying the talbiyah (meaning).
The Companion who had hady with him, so did not leave ihram, along with our Beloved Master ﷺ.
items.a: Our master 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ)

items.q: A pilgrim prevented from finishing, called this, sacrifices and leaves ihram.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ and His ﷺ Companions were prevented at this place in 6 AH / 628 CE.
The 'Umrah done the next year in place of it.
The number of 'Umrahs our Beloved Prophet ﷺ did, by Anas's count.
The month in which all of his 'Umrahs except the one with his Hajj were done.
Our Beloved Master ﷺ said 'Umrah in Ramadan equals this (paraphrased).
Hajj on behalf of someone else, called this.
The woman of Khath'am who asked to do Hajj for her old father, who could not sit on a mount.
The Companion who was riding behind our Beloved Prophet ﷺ when the Khath'ami woman asked.
